items.title: Deadline to object to price change by special termination
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag in Textform erreichen; Kosten entstehen Ihnen dadurch nicht.
items.computation: The letter announces a price change effective 01.01.2027 and grants a special right of termination ('fristlos zum 01.01.2027'). The cancellation must reach the provider 'vor diesem Tag' (before 01.01.2027), i.e. it must arrive at the latest on the day before, which is 31.12.2026. This is a fixed calendar deadline stated in the letter, not a statutory period subject to §§ 187-193 BGB counting; no weekend/holiday shift applies because the letter itself fixes the last day of arrival, and 31.12.2026 is a Thursday (business day) in any case.

warnings: The letter is a price-increase notice from a private energy company, not an authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the cancellation deadline (31.12.2026) is taken directly from the wording 'vor diesem Tag' (before 01.01.2027). The IBAN printed (DE62 3705 0198 0005 5334 40) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but this only confirms its format, not that it truly belongs to Beispielstrom Mittelhessen GmbH; if you ever need to pay or verify account details, confirm them independently rather than relying solely on this letter.
